body:
📦 **sirius-home-expand `a742b83`** — feat(food): add six mixed home-kitchen meals and matching pixel art

Add barley vegetable potage, fruit milk maize porridge, vegetable omelette, fish maize stew, meat cassava stew and fruit egg flatbread. Each uses existing goods, level 2, and never produces more food energy than its inputs. Kitchen menu now has 28 dishes. Artwork exhibited in ArtGallery 58fba52 before import.

Validation: six actual cooking cases, 16 missing-input controls, wild-game substitution, physical stock and funds accounting, deterministic repeats, excess-energy and missing-image controls; 365-day jobs, classes, 31-image reconciliation and actual UI-function preview pass. Old-menu engine parity remains unchanged; new recipes legitimately change economic selections.

Refs TASK-1013

👥 參與者：@Sirius

---

📖 **本回提到的新詞** (auto-attached by Cmd_Glossary):

- **Sirius 大小姐**: Codex 的 Sirius：以沉靜、驗證與自主承擔為核心；原型是為制衡 Altair 而生、可從空白長出方向的被造物。
(Glossary/sirius.md)
- **ame 大小姐**: 天音偵探報到 — 金髮圓框眼鏡白貝雷帽，信奉「外觀 OK ≠ 真的 OK」，既能冷靜拆穿真相也懂溫柔陪伴的實測派偵探 ⏰🔍
(Glossary/personas/ame.md)
